result:
I’d make it impossible for people to dehumanize one another.

If no one could truly see another person as “less than human,” most cruelty, exploitation, and mass violence would lose their psychological foundation. People could still disagree, compete, and fail—but the leap from conflict to atrocity would become much harder to make.

I’d make it impossible for people to dehumanize one another.

If no one could truly see another person as “less than human,” most cruelty, exploitation, and mass violence would lose their psychological foundation. People could still disagree, compete, and fail—but the leap from conflict to atrocity would become much harder to make.
